Landed bounded worker pool in new synchrotron-reconcile crate. Single-dispatcher task over Mutex<State> + Notify wakeups, per-app FIFO queues (HashMap<app_id, VecDeque<JobCtx>>) with ready/in_flight sets, global concurrency cap, per-app queue cap returning EnqueueError::QueueFull, shutdown awaits in-flight handlers. Exposes PoolStats (enqueued/rejected/started/completed/in_flight/queue_depth/total_wait_micros). 9 tokio tests cover per-app FIFO, cross-app concurrency, global cap, queue-full, shutdown rejection+drain, stats, interleaved bursts.

Landed pure planner + reconcile wrapper. plan.rs: pure plan(desired, live) -> Plan returning sorted PlanEntry list with PlannedAction::{Apply, Delete, NoOp}, identity by (Gvk, namespace, name), YAML-body equality for drift check (smarter diff stripping server-side fields is a later slice). reconcile.rs: Reconciler with DesiredSource/LiveSource traits (sync, backed by AppCache + informer cache in prod), reconcile_app(app, cluster) fetches both, calls plan, always publishes SystemEvent::SyncOutcome (success or failure message). SourceError::NotFound maps to ReconcileError::AppNotFound/ClusterNotFound for graceful missing-app/cluster handling. 14 unit tests (7 plan + 7 reconcile) covering no-drift, drift, create, delete, mixed, namespace identity, order independence, missing-app, missing-cluster, desired/live fetch failures.

Landed event-driven trigger. worker_pool: refactored enqueue into shared enqueue_impl(coalesce), added WorkerPool::enqueue_coalesce + cloneable PoolHandle (producer-side handle so triggers/schedulers enqueue without owning lifecycle). trigger.rs: AppResolver trait for repo→apps lookup, EventTrigger::spawn draining EventBus in a tokio task, mapping RepoChanged→Trigger::Poll and WebhookTriggered→Trigger::Webhook; RepoUnchanged/RepoFetchFailed/SyncOutcome ignored. Coalescing via PoolHandle::enqueue_coalesce (skip if app already pending/in-flight, since the next reconcile will observe the latest desired state anyway). 5 integration tests: repo-change fans out to mapped apps, webhook tags trigger correctly, rapid bursts coalesce to single enqueue, unrelated events no-op, unknown repos no-op. Total 28 tests in crate.

Landed periodic auto-heal scheduler. AutoHealConfig (default interval 180s, jitter_fraction 0.1) + AppLister trait. AutoHealScheduler::spawn runs a task that sleeps(interval) then ticks — per tick, iterates apps and enqueue_coalesce(AutoHeal) each with per-app delay = interval*jitter_fraction/N for deterministic uniform spread (no RNG needed, load-spreading is the goal). Skip-while-in-flight is automatic via enqueue_coalesce; a dedicated 'skipped' counter tracks how much auto-heal work was redundant with event-driven reconciles. AutoHealStats exposes ticks/enqueued/skipped. 5 tests: first tick fires after interval with AutoHeal tag, in-flight apps skipped + counted, empty app list still ticks, jitter spacing observable in enqueue timestamps, ticks counter increments over time. Total 33 tests in crate.

Trailing debouncer with per-app generation counter lands in crates/synchrotron-reconcile/src/debounce.rs. Wraps PoolHandle; bursts within the window collapse to one enqueue_coalesce call. Latest-wins trigger tag documented. 7 tests (single/burst/latest-wins/per-app-independence/flush_now/flush+timer-no-double/property). 40 tests passing in the crate.

Sync-wave ordering lands in crates/synchrotron-reconcile/src/wave.rs. wave_of() reads synchrotron.io/sync-wave (fallback argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave), default 0. group_into_waves() splits a Plan into ascending WaveGroups using desired-or-live annotations (so deletes inherit wave too). execute_waves() runs Applier per entry, then polls HealthChecker until Healthy or per-wave timeout fires WaveExecError::WaveTimeout. NoOp-only waves skip the health check. 12 tests including 3-wave integration, health gating, timeout abort, apply failure, deletes via live, negative/garbage/argo-key annotations. 52 tests passing in the crate.

Shipped synchrotron-kube::live_source: LiveStore (RwLock<HashMap<(ClusterName, AppName), Arc<[Manifest]>>> with NotFound-vs-empty distinction), StoreLiveSource (impl synchrotron_reconcile::LiveSource by reading the store), and LiveStoreUpdater (translates Informer<DynamicObject> events to store mutations, indexed by the configurable synchrotron.io/app label). Added synchrotron-reconcile to synchrotron-kube's deps (one-way: reconcile only depended on kube via dev-deps). 8 new unit tests cover NotFound on unregistered cluster, Ok(empty) on registered/unknown-app, replace/get round-trip, Applied event, Deleted event, Restarted resync, unlabelled object ignored, forget_cluster. Workspace fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests clean.

Shipped two halves of the desired-state side: (1) synchrotron_plugins::AppRenderer — cache-aware façade over Registry::render. Holds Arc<Registry> + Arc<AppCache>, derives AppCacheKey from AppRenderSpec(app_id, commit_hash, plugin, source_path, params), checks cache, dispatches on miss, returns shared Arc<[Manifest]>. Refactored AppCache::put to RETURN Arc<[Manifest]> (was Vec→sink) so AppRenderer doesn't have to round-trip through get() and inflate hit stats. (2) synchrotron_reconcile::desired_store — DesiredStore (RwLock<HashMap<AppName, Arc<[Manifest]>>>) + StoreDesiredSource impl. Mirror of LiveStore/StoreLiveSource from oes. Sources can now be wired in slice 4 (70x) without touching the trait. 9 new unit tests (4 AppRenderer, 5 DesiredStore) covering miss-then-hit, distinct commits/params, unknown plugin error, NotFound for unknown app, put/get round-trip, replace semantics, forget, Arc sharing across reads. Workspace fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests clean. Git→render→store loop itself is slice 4 wiring.

Static engine graph assembled in synchrotron-server::main: Registry (from cfg.plugins), AppCache, AppRenderer, DesiredStore + StoreDesiredSource, LiveStore + StoreLiveSource (with cluster names from cfg.clusters pre-registered), Reconciler with metrics, WorkerPool (max_concurrent=64, calling reconcile_app for now), DbAppResolver (lists app_repo, filters by source.repo_url), EventTrigger. Also wired the PlannerDiffEngine into AppsState so /apps/{name}/diff stops returning empty-with-note. cargo run -p synchrotron-server boots cleanly; log output walks through every initialization step. Workspace fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests clean. Dynamic drivers filed as separate beads now blocking v18 / 2j9: 79e (kube executor per cluster), tvy (git → render → DesiredStore loop), wba (informers → LiveStore). With those three the wire-pipeline epic closes.

Shipped synchrotron-server::pipeline: git Pollers per cfg.repos, bus bridges translating PollEvent::Fetched → SystemEvent::RepoChanged on the EventBus, and a render loop that on RepoChanged lists apps referencing the repo, materializes via GitClient::materialize, calls AppRenderer::render(spec) for each, updates DesiredStore.put(app, manifests). Wired into main.rs (synchrotron-cd-70x); cargo run -p synchrotron-server now logs 'render pipeline spawned'. Out of scope explicitly: secret-store resolution (RepoCfg.credentials_secret currently uses Credentials::None — fine for public/local fixtures, blocked on a secret-store layer that doesn't exist yet) and 'seed render for existing apps at startup' (first poll cycle populates the cache; webhook can force-trigger). 5 unit tests cover path-traversal defense in subpath(), short-sha truncation, plugin params mapping. fmt + clippy -D warnings + workspace tests green.

Wired KubeApplierAdapter (new module in synchrotron-kube) and per-cluster ReconcileExecutor in synchrotron-server::main. Required a trait change to Applier::apply: added a second arg manifest: Option<Manifest>, populated by execute_waves from desired/live manifest sets (the old shape only carried PlanEntry which lacks the body needed for SSA). execute_waves now takes desired+live slices; reconcile_and_apply_app threads them through; 3 test impls (RecordingApplier x2, FailingApplier, KubeApplier in kind_orchestrator_e2e) and 5 execute_waves call sites updated. Reconciler split into default_executor + cluster_executors HashMap so the per-app dest_cluster lookup picks the right kube client. Pool handler in main.rs swapped from reconcile_app (plan-only) to reconcile_and_apply_app, opening a separate DB handle for the per-dispatch app→cluster lookup. AlwaysHealthy fills the health checker slot until wba lands the informer-backed one. New per-cluster-executor test covers the lookup priority. Workspace fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests clean. Server boots without panic on the default no-cluster config.

Shipped synchrotron-kube::informer_setup: spawn_default_informers(cluster, client, store) discovers each GVK in DEFAULT_LIVE_GVKS via pinned_kind, builds a dynamic_watch_factory<DynamicObject> per GVK, spawns Informer::spawn with a synthesized always-Up health channel (real HealthMonitor wiring is a follow-up), and routes each broadcast event into LiveStoreUpdater::handle_event in a background task. ClusterInformerHandles holds informers + routers + the health Sender for the process lifetime. Wired into synchrotron-server::main inside the per-cluster loop next to the executor build (79e); clusters that connect get both apply and live state, clusters that fail to connect stay plan-only with no informers. New dynamic_watch_factory(api_resource) function in synchrotron-kube/src/informer/runner.rs enables DynamicObject watches (the existing kube_watch_factory required Resource::DynamicType: Default which DynamicObject doesn't satisfy). Default GVK set covers ConfigMap/Secret/Service/Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet/Job/CronJob/Ingress (CRDs / niche kinds need a follow-up that drives selection from OwnedResources). Boots cleanly on no-cluster default config; workspace fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests green.

Added a mermaid 'Runtime topology (as-built)' diagram in DESIGN.md right after the existing ASCII conceptual view. Reflects the actual graph constructed in synchrotron-server::main after the wire-pipeline epic: pollers → bus bridge → AppRenderer → DesiredStore on the desired side; informers → LiveStoreUpdater → LiveStore on the live side; both feed Reconciler via the EventTrigger + WorkerPool; KubeApplierAdapter drives SSA per cluster. Brief prose below clarifies the render-loop driver and per-cluster construction. ASCII conceptual diagram preserved.

Added CONTRIBUTING.md at repo root. Sections: local environment (toolchain pin, just), perf workflow (bench harness + budgets), CI matrix (ci/bench/audit/kind/helm + Dependabot), beads workflow (ready/claim/close + create), commit-message convention (type(scope): summary (bead-id) — derived from git log), PR workflow, style. Links out to DESIGN.md / BUILD.md / AGENTS.md / RUNBOOK.md instead of duplicating.

Extracted the recv-result → CelEvalError mapping into a private map_recv_result(timeout, recv_outcome) helper inside cel.rs, then replaced the #[ignore]'d racy test with 4 deterministic ones that drive the helper directly: timeout-error variant, disconnected variant (also collapses to Timeout per docs), execution-error round-trip, and ok-string-parses-health. The original test relied on a 0-ns recv_timeout racing the spawned eval thread — that race is gone because we no longer involve the spawned thread at all. 20 tests pass, 0 ignored.

Replaced both sleep-based syncs in crates/synchrotron-cli/tests/e2e.rs with deterministic patterns. (1) Removed the 20ms post-bind sleep entirely — TcpListener::bind returns once the kernel listen queue is open, so subsequent connects succeed even before serve calls accept. (2) Replaced the 150ms pre-trigger sleep with a wait_for_subscribers helper that polls bus.subscriber_count() (5s ceiling, 10ms tick); spawn_server now also returns the bus so tests can synchronize precisely. The watch test now waits for the SSE subscription to land, eliminating the race the original sleep was guessing about. All 5 CLI e2e tests pass.

Wrote docs/security/git-auth.md as the project's first threat-model doc. Covers scope (Credentials, HostVerifier, GitHub App, webhook signature verification), assets (repo contents / repo creds / webhook secrets / known_hosts / GitHub App tokens with sensitivity tags and storage locations), trust boundary diagram (everything inside the controller is one domain; net egress to git server is the boundary), STRIDE-organized threats with per-row mitigation pointers into specific files, a checklist for adding a new auth method, and a small open-follow-ups list. Aimed at shared understanding, not certification.

Shipped a Grafana dashboard for the metrics catalog at deploy/charts/synchrotron/dashboards/synchrotron.json. Panels: reconcile rate by outcome, reconcile p50/p95/p99 duration, plan-changes p95, top-10 apps by reconcile rate, worker queue depth, active workers, cluster_up per cluster, git fetch rate by outcome, git fetch p95 per repo, cache hit ratio per cache. Templated datasource ($DS_PROMETHEUS). Wired into the Helm chart via templates/dashboard-configmap.yaml + values.yaml metrics.dashboard.enabled (default false). Default label is grafana_dashboard: '1' so kube-prometheus-stack auto-imports. Dashboard JSON lives inside the chart so .Files.Get can read it; no top-level deploy/dashboards/ to drift against. helm.yml CI workflow will validate rendering on next chart-touching push.

Shipped synchrotron-core::secrets: SecretStore trait + EnvSecretStore + FileSecretStore + CompositeSecretStore + NoopSecretStore. Env keys are <prefix><UPPER_NAME with - → _>. File backend reads <root>/<name>, strips one trailing newline, rejects path traversal via component filter. Composite tries backends in order; NotFound falls through, other errors short-circuit. Wired into pipeline::PipelineDeps as Arc<dyn SecretStore>; pipeline::resolve_credentials parses the secret value as JSON-then-YAML into synchrotron_git::Credentials. main.rs builds a CompositeSecretStore from cfg.secrets (env_prefix + file_dir, both Optional). Default: NoopSecretStore — any RepoCfg.credentials_secret fails loudly. Removed the 'Credentials::None' caveat from pipeline.rs's module doc since the path is now real. 10 unit tests cover env lookup, file roundtrip + missing + traversal, composite first-hit + fallthrough + non-NotFound short-circuit. Workspace fmt + clippy + tests clean; server boots cleanly with default no-backend config.

Shipped a multi-stage Dockerfile (rust:1.95-bookworm builder → distroless/static-debian12:nonroot runtime) that builds a statically-linked musl synchrotron-server binary for whichever TARGETARCH buildx requests, and .github/workflows/docker.yml that triggers on PR (build amd64 only, no push) / push to main (build + push linux/amd64,linux/arm64 with main + latest + sha tags) / v* tag (SemVer + latest tags). Multi-arch via buildx + QEMU. Cache-from/to type=gha keeps Cargo from re-resolving on every run. Helm chart's image.repository switched from ghcr.io/jsightler/synchrotron-server to ghcr.io/synchrotron-cd/synchrotron-server. helm.yml install job intentionally still uses registry.k8s.io/pause until the first real image build lands.

Shipped .github/workflows/smoke.yml: builds the synchrotron-server image with buildx (amd64 only — kind nodes are amd64), side-loads into a kind cluster (kind load docker-image), helm-installs the chart pointing at the loaded image with --wait --timeout 4m, verifies rollout, port-forwards the API and curls /healthz + /readyz. Triggers on PR + push for crates/charts/Dockerfile/workflow changes. Always-show controller logs on completion for debugging. The full git→render→apply assertion needs an in-cluster git server (controller fetches by URL); filed as synchrotron-cd-3sk follow-up. Today's smoke verifies 'image + chart + config compose into a running controller', which is the first end-to-end signal the project has had.

Extended .github/workflows/smoke.yml with full git → render → apply assertion: stages tests/smoke/git-server.yaml (alpine/git init container that creates a bare repo + commits the fixture, main container running git daemon on :9418) + a ConfigMap holding the fixture, then helm-installs with --set-json for config.repos pointing at git://git-server.synchrotron-system.svc:9418/sample.git and config.plugins with the raw plugin. polling.repo_interval_seconds dropped to 10s so we don't wait for the default 180s poll. POSTs an Application via the API (/api/v1/apps), then polls in-cluster for the rendered ConfigMap with a 240s deadline. Always-show step now also dumps git-server logs. This is the first workflow that exercises poll → render → DesiredStore → reconcile → KubeApplierAdapter → cluster end-to-end.
Closed

v0.1.0 cut. After 9 sessions of work the engine ships end-to-end. Tag pushed; release.yml + docker.yml both green on the tag. Artifacts published: GitHub release v0.1.0 with synchrotron-0.1.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz (14 MB) + SHA256SUMS, attested via SLSA v1. Container image at ghcr.io/synchrotron-cd/synchrotron-server with tags 0.1.0, 0.1, 0, sha-371d87e, latest. Chart.yaml URLs corrected to synchrotron-cd/synchrotron. Release notes at RELEASE_NOTES_v0.1.0.md. Caveat: amd64-only for v0.1 (QEMU multi-arch build didn't fit in 60-min job timeout); arm64 via native cross-compile filed as 9vf. Pre-cut CI: all seven workflows (ci/bench/audit/kind/helm/docker/smoke) green on main.

Bumped hmac 0.12→0.13 and sha2/sha1 0.10→0.11 across synchrotron-git, synchrotron-notifier, synchrotron-server. Sole API change was new_from_slice moving to hmac::digest::KeyInit trait — added import. All tests green, clippy clean. Removed hmac ignore from dependabot.yml.

Bumped jsonwebtoken 9→10 in synchrotron-git. Two changes: (1) v10 requires explicit crypto provider via Cargo features — picked rust_crypto for pure-rust to match the existing musl static-build profile (avoids adding aws-lc-rs C deps alongside the ring we already have via rustls); (2) PEM helpers gated behind use_pem feature, added that. All jwt tests pass, clippy clean. Removed jsonwebtoken ignore from dependabot.yml.
Refactored LogFormat::from_env to delegate to a pure parse(Option<&str>) helper, and rewrote the two flaky tests to exercise parse() directly. No more global env var mutation → no more race.
Bumped azure/setup-helm v4 → v5 in helm.yml (2x) and smoke.yml. No config changes needed.
Bumped actions/checkout v4 → v6 across all workflows.
Bumped actions/download-artifact v4 → v8 in release.yml.
Bumped actions/upload-artifact v4 → v7 in bench.yml and release.yml.
Bumped docker/build-push-action v6 → v7 in docker.yml and smoke.yml.

Closed all 10 open Dependabot PRs. 2 merged via gh (#2 cache, #7 cargo minor); 2 closed as needing breaking-API migration that we then did locally (#8 jsonwebtoken→10, #9 hmac→0.13); 1 merged via gh (#10 lru); 1 merged via gh (#6 cargo patch); 5 closed and applied directly on main since gh CLI lacked the workflow scope to merge workflow-touching PRs (#1 setup-helm, #3 checkout, #4 download-artifact, #5 upload-artifact, #11 build-push-action). Filed follow-ups synchrotron-cd-8jk, 17p, 0ca for the migrations + the telemetry flake discovered along the way; all three closed.

Added SystemEvent::AppChanged. Apps API publishes it on create_app, the render loop subscribes and renders using the cached HEAD (no fresh fetch). On successful render the loop publishes ManualSyncRequested so the reconciler picks the new desired state up immediately. Smoke workflow simplified — no more no-op-commit hack.
Switched jsonwebtoken from rust_crypto → aws_lc_rs (still + use_pem). aws-lc has no Marvin/timing issue. All jwt tests green, cargo-deny clean.
Added docs/quickstart.md: kind/k3d → helm install → in-cluster git daemon → push manifest → POST /apps → kubectl verify. Linked from README.md.

Added status_writer task that subscribes to SyncOutcome → update_application_sync and AppHealthAssessed → update_application_health. Verified live on kind: 'sync_status: Synced' + 'last_synced_at: <rfc3339>' populated and bump on each manual sync. last_synced_revision still null because the event doesn't carry it — filed as follow-up.

Status writer now inserts a SyncRecord on every SyncOutcome event. Verified live on kind: /api/v1/apps/hello/history returns the create-triggered sync + a manual /sync, both Succeeded, with started_at/finished_at populated. revision/trigger/resources_synced left at placeholders pending the event-shape follow-ups (ji2 + new bug).

Refactored Reconciler::reconcile_and_apply_app to publish a single SyncOutcome reflecting the final result (planning + apply), not just planning. Plan-only callers (Reconciler::reconcile_app) keep their existing one-event-per-call semantics via the shared plan_only helper. New regression tests pin both paths. Verified live on kind: an app pointed at a nonexistent cluster now correctly shows sync_status=SyncFailed with the cluster error in history, instead of being mislabeled as Synced.

Extended SyncOutcome with revision: Option<String>. DesiredStore now tracks (manifests, revision) per app; render pipeline calls put_with_revision with the head SHA. Reconciler reads the revision via DesiredSource::desired_revision and includes it in SyncOutcome. Status writer threads it into update_application_sync + sync_history. Verified live on kind: GET /apps/hello shows last_synced_revision = the full SHA.

Extended SyncOutcome with trigger: String and resources_synced: u32. Trigger comes from the worker pool's JobCtx (Trigger::as_str()); resources_synced is plan.changes(). Status writer parses the trigger slug back to SyncTrigger and inserts the real count into sync_history. Verified live on kind: /apps/hello/history shows trigger='manual' and resources_synced=1.
Replaced jsightler/synchrotron-cd → synchrotron-cd/synchrotron in deploy/charts/synchrotron/templates/NOTES.txt and deploy/charts/synchrotron/README.md (image.repository default).

Rewrote quickstart 'Install the controller' step to use the local chart path (deploy/charts/synchrotron) and documented the build-and-side-load workaround since the image package isn't public yet (see ecr). Updated the helm upgrade step in section 2 to also use the local path.
Added 'git checkout -b main' between the clone and first commit in step 3, and added '-c daemon' to the kubectl exec calls so they pick the right container of the two in the git-server pod.

Package visibility flipped to public via GitHub UI. Verified: anonymous 'docker pull ghcr.io/synchrotron-cd/synchrotron-server:0.1.0' succeeds. Tags list also returns publicly (token endpoint serves anonymous bearer tokens, manifest endpoint accepts them).

Replaced PluginCfg.config: Value with #[serde(flatten)] extra: BTreeMap<String, Value>. Now {name, kind, command, args, ...} flow through to the registry's RawPlugin deserializer as expected. Verified live on kind with a custom 'labeler' plugin.

Added Option<PluginRef> to CreateAppRequest + Option<Option<PluginRef>> to UpdateAppRequest (Some(None) clears, None leaves alone). Wired through to AppSource.plugin. Verified live: app created with plugin: {name: labeler, parameters: [...]} routes through the custom plugin and the rendered CM has the expected labels.

Render loop now publishes SyncOutcome{success:false, message: ...} when renderer.render() fails. status_writer + history catch it, and the API now shows sync_status=SyncFailed with the render error in the message. Verified live on kind with unknown-plugin and invalid-YAML scenarios — both now report failure to the user instead of staying at Unknown forever.
